[Verse 1]
[D5]Dear wind of Missis-
sippi can you call him by
name
I have followed his
wings on a sunny day

[Chorus]
[A#5]I like to be-
lieve he's the
[F5]chosen one
[A#5]I like to be-
lieve he's the
[F5]fallen one
[C5]
[A#5]Dead but [C5]rising
[F5]

[Pre-Verse]
[D5]
[D#5]
[D5]
[D#5]

[Verse 2]
[D5]I raise the fist,
raise the fist with power and
fate
And wishing that his claws
will grab on to my hand

[Chorus]
[A#5]I like to be-
lieve he's the
[F5]chosen one
[A#5]I like to be-
lieve he's the
[F5]fallen one
[C5]
[A#5]Dead but [C5]rising
[F5]

[Interlude]
[F5]

[Verse 3]
[F5]I have been to the end
of waters
I have been to the
end of earth
[D5]I've been over
[C5]mountains and riding the
[F5]storms
Dear son your words
have reached me
And for that I can
carry on
[D5]I'll guide you in
[C5]spirit Today I'll be
[F5]home

[Chorus]
[A#5]I like to be-
lieve he's the
[F5]chosen one
[A#5]I like to be-
lieve he's the
[F5]fallen one
[A#5]The rebirth of
man heals a
[F5]bleeding heart
[A#5]The eagle of
kings wears my
[F5]fathers soul
[C5]
[A#5]Dead but [C5]rising
[F5]

[Bridge]
[D5]
[D#5]
[D5]
[D#5]

[Outro]
[D#5]
[D5]
title: Dead but Rising
tuning: D G C F A D
